def evolve(state: str, offsets: list[int], t: int) -> str:
    n = len(state)
    mask = (1 << n) - 1
    lamps = int(state[::-1], 2)
    shifts = [offset % n for offset in offsets]

    while t:
        if t & 1:
            next_lamps = 0
            for shift in shifts:
                next_lamps ^= ((lamps >> shift) | (lamps << (n - shift))) & mask
            lamps = next_lamps

        shifts = [(shift * 2) % n for shift in shifts]
        t >>= 1

    return format(lamps, f"0{n}b")[::-1]
